privacy.text: Skills and machine authorisations of each person, as a person decided them. No score, no figure about anyone's work, no health data.

list.title: Skills matrix
list.tableLabel: Skills and machine authorisations per person
list.emptyHint: The matrix fills once people and skills are in Nexus.
list.cut: Showing the first 500 people: choose a site or a line to see the rest.
list.foot: Levels are a person's judgement, never computed. Rows go by team or by name only: nothing adds people up or ranks them.

level.title: {skill}: level and trainee period
level.judgement: Your judgement: it is recorded with your name.
level.traineeHint: Leave it empty when this person is not in training.
level.traineeOpen: You can move the date; the period closes with the sign-off.

authorise.title: Authorise a machine
authorise.machineHint: An authorisation covers every machine of this type.
authorise.effectToday: Can work on {machine} machines from today.
authorise.firstBody: From then on, at {sites}, nobody else may work on these machines without an authorisation, and no override lifts that.
authorise.lawPlain: Work equipment needing special knowledge is used only by people put in charge of it.
authorise.notChecked: Required training and fitness are not checked here yet: they join with the safety registers.

signOff.title: Sign off a trainee
signOff.subtitle: {name} · {skill}
signOff.trainerHint: People who hold this skill as Trainer. Empty: an outside trainer.
signOff.levelHint: Optional: you assess it as you sign.
signOff.effect: This person leaves trainee status: from that day they count in line efficiency and normal pay rules.
signOff.name: Your name
signOff.nameMismatch: That is not the name of this account

remove.title: Remove {skill} from {name}?
remove.body: The level stays in the history with your reason. A new level can follow.

revoke.title: Revoke {machine} for {name}?
revoke.body: Final: the authorisation stays in the history with your reason. A new one can be given later.

stepUp.title: Your code, to sign
stepUp.signOff: Signing off a trainee needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.

problem.locked: Too many tries: wait a moment.
problem.unavailable: The code could not be checked: try again.

catalogue.title: List of skills
catalogue.subtitle: Each skill is a column of the matrix.
catalogue.codeHint: Letters, digits, . _ - and no spaces: it never changes.
catalogue.name: Name
catalogue.noOperations: Your role does not read the operation library: add a General skill, or ask someone who does.

held.noManage: Your role does not set skill levels.
held.noAuthorise: Your role does not authorise machines.
held.chooseClass: Choose a type of machine first.
held.untilBeforeFrom: The end date is before the start.
held.signOffFuture: A sign-off cannot be dated in the future.
held.signOffBefore: The sign-off is before the training started.
held.skillCode: Give a code: letters, digits, . _ - and no spaces.
held.skillClass: Choose the type of machine first.

refusal.CODE_TAKEN: This code is taken: choose another.
refusal.OPERATION_OTHER_COMPANY: This operation belongs to another company.
refusal.CLASS_INACTIVE: This type of machine is no longer in use.
refusal.SKILL_OTHER_COMPANY: This skill belongs to another company.
refusal.SELF_DECISION: Nobody decides about themselves: another person must do this.
refusal.SINCE_IN_FUTURE: The start cannot be in the future.
refusal.TRAINEE_OPEN: A trainee period stays open until it is signed off.
refusal.SIGNED_OFF: This trainee is already signed off.
refusal.NOT_A_TRAINEE: This person is not a trainee on this skill.
refusal.SIGN_OFF_BEFORE_START: The sign-off is before the training started.
refusal.SIGN_OFF_IN_FUTURE: A sign-off cannot be dated in the future.
refusal.TRAINER_IS_TRAINEE: The trainer is a trainee on this skill.
refusal.TRAINER_OTHER_COMPANY: The trainer works for another company.
refusal.TRAINER_NOT_TRAINER: This person does not hold the skill as Trainer.
refusal.LEVEL_REMOVED: This level was removed: read the page again.
refusal.AUTHORISATION_OPEN: This person is already authorised on this type of machine.
refusal.AUTHORISATION_REVOKED: This authorisation was revoked: give a new one.

field.code: Check the code: letters, digits, . _ - and no spaces.
field.name: Check the name.
field.reason: Say why, in a few words.
field.signedOffOn: Check the date of the sign-off.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.levels: Set a skill level (Learning to Trainer)

tab.judgement: What this person can do and may operate. A person decides each level; nothing is computed.
tab.tableLabel: Skills and machine authorisations of this person
